name: Mineral
line: Museum stone: the headline is cut as a Marcellus inscription into pale marble, its letters sharpening one by one from a slight blur; the one idea and Code Against Cancer sit on travertine tablets with subtly engraved numerals, the four IARC labels run as a frieze, and the two explorers stand as dark Ruskeala-marble monoliths.
notes: The inscription reveal is a small inline script that splits headings into letters (the heading keeps an aria-label); it starts once the web fonts are ready, and with JavaScript off or reduced motion the text is simply there. Engraving is a 1px light/dark text-shadow pair, kept subtle. Oxide is kept tiny: the lozenge in the hero rule, the current-language underline and the focus ring. The Ruskeala photograph is used for both monoliths with different crops and a basalt gradient for AA text. Marcellus is Latin-only with a single weight and no italic; Manrope covers Cyrillic.
